# Built-in field types

Every built-in field type. Every field also takes `name`, `label`, `description`, `placeholder`, `default`, `required`, `rules` and `ui`. A type of kind `none` takes no `default`, `required` or `rules`, and a `group` takes no `required` or `default`. The [field types](/guide/field-types) guide explains each one.

| Type | Kind | Props | Default rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string |  |  | One line of text |
| `textarea` | string |  |  | Several lines of text |
| `email` | string |  | `email` | An email address, checked by the email rule |
| `password` | string |  |  | Text hidden while typing |
| `url` | string |  | `url` | A web address, checked by the url rule |
| `tel` | string |  |  | A phone number. Add a regex rule for its format |
| `number` | number |  |  |  |
| `checkbox` | boolean |  |  | Yes or no. Required means it must be ticked |
| `date` | date | `output?`: "string" \| "date" |  | An ISO date, such as 2026-10-28 |
| `time` | date |  |  | An ISO time, such as 14:30 |
| `datetime` | date | `output?`: "string" \| "date" |  | A local ISO date and time, such as 2026-10-28T14:30 |
| `select` | from the props | `options?`: object[], at least 1; `valueType?`: "string" \| "number" |  | One of the options, or any value while they load |
| `radio` | from the props | `options`: object[], at least 1 |  | One of the options |
| `multiselect` | array, items from the props | `options`: object[], at least 1 |  | Any number of the options |
| `file` | from the props | `multiple?`: boolean; `accept?`: string |  | A file, or a list of files with multiple |
| `heading` | none | `text`: string; `level?`: integer, 1 to 6 |  | A title between fields. It has no value |
| `paragraph` | none | `text`: string |  | Plain text between fields. It has no value |
| `divider` | none |  |  | A line between fields. It has no value |
| `group` | object | `fields`: field[] |  | An object with a key for each of its fields |
| `array` | array | `of?`: field; `fields?`: field[] |  | A list of single values with of, or of objects with fields |
